_comment: Commander bracket rules. Source: the Commander Format Panel bracket system, Wizards revision of 2025-10-21, checked again against the update of 2026-02-09. Only the machine-checkable parts live here (F-11). The prose parts (mass land denial, extra-turn chains, combo timing) are not encoded yet: the engine emits an info finding that names them. A Game Changer commander counts as one of the three at Bracket 3, and can not play in Brackets 1 and 2. Verified 2026-08-26 against https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/introducing-commander-brackets-beta (the engine counts the command zone). expected_turns is the Wizards guide for the game length. -1 means no limit.
